Part A measures the area within the distance of BOTH of two straight, confirmed street lines that meet at a corner. A bent frontage, more than two streets and a lot with one street give an unknown split with a state code; what follows for such a lot is the wiring step's.

For a missing input (parts B, C, D) and for the measurement's unknown states (part A) no kind of gap is named here by design (rulings C12 and C18): naming it is owed by the wiring step (row R650 stays open for that).

Which lot area a building rests on (recorded 10,075 sq ft against the measured outline 10,387.99 sq ft) is not decided here (backlog row DB-210, point a).
Every calculation entry of the register reads 'Not reviewed': the reviews of this task are by AI agents and establish no human verdict.
Building A's storey count is the floor of allowance divided by footprint with no rounding tolerance (G4 note; backlog row DB-212 d).
